samples.source: The key points, if you remember nothing else from this presentation, parallelism is but one optimization of many. Use the right one for the job, check for a faster algorithm before you go taking hundreds of thousands of lines of code and doing some random parallelization of it. Leverage the work of others where you can. Use libraries, use frameworks, use things where there's already concurrent, and save yourself the trouble. In general, do it the easy way where possible. Your future self, to say nothing of your future colleagues, will thank you for this.
